notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.3 SR11: without DESTINATION TABLE OCCURS "one error key and one symbolic destination area are assumed. In this case, subscripting is not permitted when referencing these data items". BuildArea puts ERROR KEY and SYMBOLIC DESTINATION directly under the area with no OCCURS parent when no table is written, so SubscriptBinder.ScreenSubscriptArity refuses any written subscript (COBOL2096). Probed: OUT-DEST(1), OUT-DEST(I), OUT-ERR(1) and OUT-DEST(1)(1:3) refused; unsubscripted use and the reference modification OUT-DEST(1:3) accepted and correct. The diagnostic cites §2023:8.4.2.3.3 SR2 at --std 85 (PB4950 class). The witness refuses OUT-DEST (1).

next.reason: 1985: "If the DESTINATION TABLE OCCURS clause is not specified, one error key and one symbolic destination area are assumed."; 2023: "No candidate covers the communication description entry, DESTINATION TABLE OCCURS, error keys or symbolic destination areas.". The 2023 candidates hold no communication description entry. None covers DESTINATION TABLE OCCURS or symbolic destinations, so the communication feature is dropped.
